newsitem.title: USA: Denver Jan 97 air cargo traffic up 14.7 pct.
newsitem.headline: Denver Jan 97 air cargo traffic up 14.7 pct.

text.p: January cargo traffic at Denver International Airport was 14.7 percent higher than January 1996 levels, the airport authority reported.
The airport handled 75.5 million pounds of freight, up from 65.8 million pounds a year earlier.

Large cargo operators all posted large increases. United Airlines, which accounted for 39 percent of all DIA cargo in January, carried 13.1 per cent more, or 29.48 million pounds of freight and mail. More than half of UA's cargo is mail.
Federal Express carried 16.4 million pounds of freight, up 32 percent increase over the 12.4 million pounds carried in January 1996. FedEx accounts for 21.7 percent of Denver traffic.
Third place overall was United Parcel Service of America, which carried 10.7 million pounds, a 13.1 percent increase over 1996. UPS accounted for 14.2 percent of all Denver cargo.
No other passenger or all-cargo airline handled more than 3.9 percent of Denver's total cargo. -Air Cargo Newsroom Tel +44 171 542 7706 Fax +44 171 542 5017
